name: RSG Hiring Signals Live Ingest v2

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ companyName: $('Code · De-duplicate').all()[$itemIndex]?.json?.companyName, signalType: $('Code · De-duplicate').all()[$itemIndex]?.json?.signalType, title: $('Code · De-duplicate').all()[$itemIndex]?.json?.title, description: $('Code · De-duplicate').all()[$itemIndex]?.json?.description, source: $('Code · De-duplicate').all()[$itemIndex]?.json?.source, observedAt: $('Code · De-duplicate').all()[$itemIndex]?.json?.observedAt }) }}

meta.description: v2 of the live ingest. Two cron triggers: 06:00 CET fan-outs RSS sources to /api/ingest AND /api/hermes/analyze-signal in parallel (the Hermes hop enriches the IngestLog with intent / urgency / risk flag); 08:00 CET pulls the unified /api/intel/snapshot and posts a Markdown digest to Telegram. Designed to be imported as a draft.
